title: Knock on Doors
description: Knock your target doors to connect with voters face-to-face.

title: Make phone bank calls
description: Complete a phone bank shift to reach voters and share your message.

title: Plan and Schedule 2 Social Posts for the week
description: Plan and schedule two social posts to engage supporters and reach voters.

title: Social media update
description: Post campaign activities and photos on your channel of choice.

title: Fundraising ask
description: Make a fundraising solicitation (email and/or social) to close the month strong.

title: Email update
description: Send a campaign progress update to your email contacts.

title: Organize a Volunteer Voter Contact Event
description: Give supporters a way to give back. Plan a volunteer voter contact event.

title: Hold a Volunteer Voter Contact Event
description: Bring volunteers together to connect with voters and build momentum.

title: Attend a community event
description: Show up where voters already gather. Your plan's events list creates one card per event - festival, parade, farmers' market, holiday celebration, or candidate forum - each with its own date and address. Sign up or RSVP ahead where the event needs it.

title: Attend the local related-office meeting
description: Attend the public meeting for the office you are running for (e.g. city council). Generated from the governing body's meeting calendar, not the plan's events list.

title: Set up opponent monitoring
description: Set Google Alerts for your opponents and watch local news. Most of the time the right move is not to respond, so decide on purpose rather than reacting to everything.

title: Send a direct mail piece
description: Plan a mail program of at least three pieces over the campaign and send your first one. Repetition is what makes mail stick.

title: Record your voter contacts
description: Log the doors, calls, and conversations you had off the platform this week so your progress counts everything you've done, not just what ran through GoodParty. Continues every week through GOTV.

title: Introduction Robocall
description: Introduce yourself to voters with an automated call.

title: Introduction Text
description: Introduce yourself to voters with a text.

title: Persuasion Robocall
description: Build trust and make your case for why voters should pick you, by automated call.

title: Persuasion Text
description: Build trust and make your case by text.

title: Voter Registration Deadline
description: Final day for voters to register for this election.

title: Early Voting Start Date
description: Beginning of the early vote period.

title: Early Voting End Date
description: End of the early vote period.

title: Election Day
description: Today is Election Day! Get out and vote, and make sure your supporters do too. Good luck!

title: Create a Get Out The Vote social post
description: Remind your supporters that it is time to vote.

title: Early Voting Text
description: Encourage your supporters to vote early.

title: Election Day Reminder Robocall
description: Get out the vote with an automated call on election (or primary) day.

title: Election Day Reminder Text
description: Get out the vote with a text on election (or primary) day.

title: Build your chase list
description: Pull together the list of supporters who are with you but have not voted yet. These are the people your final push is all about.

title: Start vote tripling
description: Ask each supporter to remind three friends to vote, and write down their names. One of the cheapest ways to add votes in the final stretch.
